source: data/edr_ready.json (ECS JSON from the organisers' edr_log_generator.py)
how_this_was_derived: Recovered from the detections in edr.db after data/ground_truth.json was accidentally overwritten by scripts/generate_sample.py, which used to write the same filename. The planted steps are identifiable because they were INJECTED on exact minute boundaries (seconds = 00) while the generator's background noise carries random seconds: 11 events on this day sit on an exact minute, and they are these 8 steps plus a duplicate T1110 row and a T1105 companion to the exfiltration. Cross-checked against the attack chain prepare_edr.py plants. The two generators now write ground_truth_edr.json and ground_truth_flat.json so the collision cannot recur.
